messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 45):
"""
45) IRDAI / HLT/ MISC / CIR /190 / 07/ 2020 dated 16-07-2020 Guidelines on settlement of claims on treatment at ‘make-shift or temporary hospitals’ as permitted by Government. 46) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/192/07/2020 dated 21-07-2020 Filing of “Corona Kavach Policy” as group health insurance product 47) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/235/09/2020d ated 10-09-2020 Issuance of Electronic Policies and dispensing with physical documents and wet signature in the wake of COVID-19 pandemic. 48) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/253/ 10 /2020 dated 13-10-2020 Norms on Renewability, Portability and Migration of Standard COVID Specific products have been issued. 49) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/061/03/2021d ated 24.3.2021 Extension of timelines for sale and renewal of short term Covid specific health insurance policies specified. 50) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/062/03/2021 dated 24.3.2021 Extension of time lines - IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/235/09/2020dated 10- 09-2020 51) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/ 99 /04/2021 dated 22.4.2021 Circular to insurance companies to ensure cashless facility at all empaneled network providers.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the deadline for filing a Corona Kavach Policy as a group health insurance product?","answer":"The deadline for filing a Corona Kavach Policy as a group health insurance product is 21-07-2020.","facts":["IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/192/07/2020 dated 21-07-2020 Filing of “Corona Kavach Policy” as group health insurance product"]},{"question":"When did the IRDAI issue norms on renewability, portability and migration of standard COVID specific products?","answer":"The norms on renewability, portability and migration of standard COVID specific products were issued on 13-10-2020.","facts":["IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/253/10/2020 dated 13-10-2020 Norms on Renewability, Portability and Migration of Standard COVID Specific products have been issued"]}]}
